status: diagnostic, cloud-agent VM (Intel Xeon guest); chose the design, is not evidence of a speedup

summary.reading: Prefetch does not overlap lookups into the 2-4 GiB tables (lookup-only: prefetched about as slow as unprefetched; in situ ~140 ns per probe remain), halving the slot to 16 bytes changes almost nothing, and 4 KiB pages make the big tables much slower while the 32 MiB filter is unchanged and its prefetches do overlap. The limit is address translation for a working set far beyond TLB reach (page walks whose own entries miss the caches, few walks in flight), not bytes per slot; a small filter whose translations stay resident removes it for the ~97.6% of probes it rejects.
